description: NaCo₂(SeO₃)₂(OH) crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-76°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.09 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.17 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.71 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) Se-O bond length. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and two longer (1.72 Å) Se-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Co and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Co and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Co, and one Se atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaCo₂Se tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one Se atom.
